items.body: Sudan Dudan is a Norwegian duo, Marit Karlberg and Anders Erik R�ine, who have released four albums over the last twenty years. On M�rke refrenger , their fifth, they are joined by Hans Hulb�kmo and Magnus Skavhaug Nergaard, contributing instrumentally and with the production. There are eight songs on the album with accompaniment principally led by acoustic guitar, augmented by fiddles, langeleik, lyre, jaws harp and more. The opening track, �Gard og grind� (�Fence and gate�) is a fine introduction to what is to come: finger-picked acoustic guitar, fiddle, bass and snare-drum played with brushes leading into the harmonized vocal, together creating an alluring sound drawing the listener in. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The mood of the album, reflected in its title which translates as �Dark Refrains,� is not always dark, but most of the material, including the title track, certainly has a reflective quality. According to the press release �the lyrics smoulder with unease about the present and the future, while looking back to the myths and riddles of the past. They speak of the earth, the sun, the moon, stars and planets, of lost brothers, quarrelling sisters, loss and grief, of the power of imagination, and of the answers to the simplest and most difficult riddles.� The lyrics of all the songs, in Norwegian, are included in the sleeve notes and while a hasty online translation can aid with some understanding, the full meanings tend to remain cryptic, but there is a sense that words and music complement each other. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan For all its dark moodiness, M�rke refrenger does have its lighter moments. �Bagatelle� recalls and reinvents the melody of a well-known French song, adding some off-kilter harmonies, while �Rulleball� is more characteristically Norwegian, employing a vocal style known as tralling in which words are replaced by a vocalization of the melody, originally used to accompany dances when no instrument was available. No translation necessary there. M�rke refrenger by Sudan Dudan The final track �Skriften p� veggen� (�the writing on the wall�) features, for the only time on the album, electric guitar. The sound is deep and twangy, shades of Duane Eddy or a David Lynch soundtrack and it works very well. All in all a fine, imaginatively conceived and beautifully produced record, available as a download or vinyl. Find the artists online. items.body:
According to its founder, Eugene Rodriguez, who also sings and plays on the record, Los Cenzontles is a �musical group and non-profit organization, which I founded over thirty years ago.�  As he continues in the album�s liner notes, the group �has a long history of producing projects exploring Mexico�s deep roots and our connections with various traditions that, so far, have included Irish, Louisiana Creole, Cuban, American cowboy, classical, pop, rock, and blues�, the latest of which is
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
. Los Cenzontles translates to the mockingbird, or, from its Aztec root word, the bird of four hundred voices. This is a fitting name for the range of musical diversity represented here.
With songs sung in Spanish, Hawaiian, and English, the concept traces back to the legacy of Mexican cowboys who travelled from California to the Hawaiian Islands to wrangle the long-horned cattle introduced there in the nineteenth century. They also brought the guitar. The 16 tracks feature old Hawaiian songs with new Spanish lyrics, old Mexican songs with new Hawaiian lyrics, new compositions, and traditional Americana. Yet it is an entirely cohesive musical package held together by dense arrangements of ukuleles, guitars, Mexican harp, and accordion.
Sonny Lim & David Hidalgo
Besides their distinctive voices, the headline artists Taj Mahal and David Hidalgo provide the gravitas and musicianship that their long and distinguished careers have earned. According to the liner notes, they were the catalysts behind the project and facilitated the choice of songs, arrangements, and played a range of instruments. On vocals they are joined by Hawaiian natives Gary Haleamau, Sheldeen Haleamau, Sonny Lim, and long-time Cenzontles member Fabiola Trujillo.
Deportee
To give a taste of the sessions, included before the traditional �Fishin� Blues� is Taj Mahal teaching the musicians how to play it. Sung by David Hildalgo,  the lovely �A Matter of Time� comes from the 1984 album
Will the Wolf Survive
by his most famous project, Los Lobos. Another standout for me, �Navegar� features a slack string guitar solo reminiscent of Duane Eddie and one of many tasty lap steel turns by Sonny Lim. Their interpretation of Woody Guthrie's �Deportee� moves into social commentary, highlighting the cruel realities of being a migrant worker in America.
Vaquero Paniolo
Recorded over five days, mostly live in one room at the Los Cenzontles headquarters in San Pablo, California, including the talents of some of their academy�s students, the recording has real spontaneity to it. Arrangements are stretched by improvisations, sometimes by several different instruments on a single tune. The project also represents a great spirit of cooperation and diversity of language, culture, age, and gender. It includes the inputs of musical legends, seasoned pros, and amateurs. The wonderfully rich and often stereotyped musical cultures of both Mexico and Hawaii are represented here with the authenticity of lived experience.
Adios Ke Aloha: Waves of the Same Sea
is a worthy addition to Los Cenzontles� important work. Quoting Rodriguez again, �Culture is a fabric within which we are all woven.�

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张现场专辑录制于1999年德国莱茵河畔洛勒莱露天剧场，由西德意志广播公司WDR的Rockpalast节目存档发行。Dr. John以钢琴和吉他为核心，与新奥尔良乐手组成四人乐队，呈现一场融合新奥尔良传统与个人创作的狂欢节式演出。曲目涵盖经典Mardi Gras曲目'Iko Iko'、Night Tripper时期代表作'I Walk on Guilded Splinters'，以及对Duke Ellington和Earl King的致敬。乐评详细描述了洛勒莱的地理与文化背景如何与Dr. John的神秘主义风格相契合。作为主流音乐人的档案性现场录音，与实验、前卫或电子音乐关联较弱，但在世界音乐维度上具有一定的新奥尔良地域文化价值。

items.body: Editor's note: When this set of recordings came to me, I was at a loss as to how to share it. It's not music, in any traditional sense (although there is some freestyle rapping), and a 'review' of such an artifact of reality seems superfluous to the content. Instead, I asked sound recordist Ian Brennan if I could simply use his own brief commentary and the recordings he made on the street in Chicago. Twenty-five people afflicted by gun violence participated, many from the very block we�d setup on. Many neighbors were pulled-in spontaneously. Almost every one in the community had been impacted by violence somehow� both on the receiving and the inflicting end, and many both. One woman had just come from a memorial service, another was on her way. That�s how far-reaching the violence. Almost no one went untouched. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors By chance, we convened on the day that Trump ordered the deployment of the National Guard to the city. The recording took place on the front porch of the leader's ninety-four-year-old grandmother's house�right in the heart of the ��hood,� beneath the Midway Airport�s landing path. A pair of stray pitfalls stalked the block. But the grandmother warned not of gunshots, but the mosquitoes in her yard. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors We were in a section of town that one man defined as �the forgotten parts.� Just a short jaunt from the designer clothes shops and posh hotels of the city�s Magnificent Mile, the Southside spawned such legendary Blues artists as Muddy Waters, Willie Dixon, and Howlin� Wolf. Jazz musicians like Lionel Hampton and even Benny Goodman, hailed from nearby. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors The participants ranged in age from seventeen to sixty-seven, but the pattern held true. The person who�d asserted �you�ll really want to hear my story,� was the least compelling. The reluctant, the most moving. One elder�s tough facade broke down as she shared how she�d lost both her sons. She tearfully apologized, �I�m sorry. I�m sorry. I�m sorry.� But she had nothing to be sorry for. Society is the one that owes the apology� for the staggering statistical inequities of which no reasonable defense can be made. The Forgotten Parts by Chicago Gunfire Survivors Editor's note: The full set of recordings are available on Bandcamp. Any profits from this project will be donated to Cure Violence Global , who states that their mission is "advancing an evidence-based health approach to end violence globally." When I asked him about the background sounds, producer Ian Brennan added, "No music is added. It�s all sounds from the source environment. I also ran loops/drones on a different track in the background as they spoke, and when they ended up being incidentally/somewhat magically/eerily synchronous, that is what was used for a few pieces with 'accompaniment' like some of the rap freestyles."
items._genre: field recording / spoken word / sound documentary
items._cn_summary: 这张作品并非传统意义上的音乐专辑，而是由录音师伊恩·布伦南在枪支暴力幸存者社区进行的田野录音。二十五位参与者——年龄从十七岁到六十七岁不等——围绕枪支暴力带来的创伤与记忆展开口述，录制地点选在南区的祖母家前廊，正处于中途机场降落航道下方。一些人刚从追悼会赶来，另一些人则正准备前往。一位失去两个儿子的年长者反复道歉，声音哽咽。编辑放弃传统乐评形式，直接呈现录音师的简短评论与原始录音片段。专辑不添加任何音乐，仅保留现场环境声。项目收益将捐给以健康方法终结暴力的公益组织。这一类型混杂田野录音与口述内容，与实验音乐存在交集，但在音乐属性上较为边缘。

items.body: The Fat White / Decius frontman has announced his second book, Tears Of The Patriarch; we're delighted to present an extract from it. Portrait: Brian David Stevens. Other photographs: Yaz Saoudi Tears Of The Patriarch is Lias Saoudi's second book, due to be published by White Rabbit early next year. In 2014 Lias and his brother Yaz travelled to North Africa to recreate the 'Bittersweet Symphony' for an experimental Fat White Family single about circumcision. Which was all fun and games until the pair ended up in Algerian jail... All these bands speaking in regional accents instead of singing, it vexed me. Vexed me because I have no region. Vexed me because it seemed like a cult of authenticity, a provincial fetish... The post Today You Become Man, New Writing by Lias Saoudi appeared first on The Quietus.

items.body: Review by Warthur — Before Le Orme retooled themselves as a prog act, they were putting out British Invasion-inspiredpsychedelia, a sound captured on this brief debut album. It's decent enough fare, and the groundingin psychedelic rock probably put the band in a good position to shift gear to prog in the early1970s, essentially engaging in parallel evolution alongside Genesis, whose debut is similarlyuncharacteristic of their later sound and similarly steeped in psychedelic trends of the era.Appreciated in its own right, this is decent enough if you're a big psychedelia fan, but it won'tscratch the itch if you're in the mood for anything that sounds like anything the band recordedafter this.
items._genre: psychedelic rock / beat / Italian progressive pre-cursor
items._cn_summary: 这是意大利乐队Le Orme在1969年发行的首张专辑，尚未转型为前卫摇滚，风格停留在英国入侵浪潮影响下的迷幻摇滚层面。乐评将其与Genesis的首张专辑类比，认为两张作品都带有强烈的时代迷幻色彩，却尚未展现乐队后期形成的成熟风格。整张专辑篇幅短小，作为乐队发展历程的早期记录具有一定意义，乐评承认其在迷幻摇滚范畴内质量尚可，但对于期待Le Orme后续那种成熟前卫摇滚听感的听众来说，这张作品可能无法满足期待。专辑本身缺乏实验性突破，更接近当时主流的迷幻摇滚潮流，与用户偏好的前卫实验、爵士即兴、电子、世界音乐等方向相距较远。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Still Thick As A Brick? Of course, this title evokes that of Jethro Tull's masterpiece, *Thick As A Brick* (TAAB for those in the know or the lazy), to which Ian Anderson himself gave a sequel 40 years later: *Thick As A Brick 2* (2012). *Still Thick As A Brick* isn't Tull's *TAAB* Episode 3, but rather the album by a new band led by Berlin-based Lutz Meinert?who also fronts the psychedelic rock band Margin?supported on acoustic guitar and vocals by Englishman Paul Forrest, a member of the Jethro Tull Experience, Crystal Palace guitarist Nils Conrad, and American flutist Ulla Hartmuth, whose virtuosity on the instrument rivals that of Ian Anderson. Despite nearly identical track titles (of course, it's a joke?), *Still Thick As A Brick* is neither a sequel to *TAAB* nor a simple cover of that legendary album. Just as TAAB told the story of Gerald Bostock, Still Thick As A Brick aims to tell the story of an inspiring figure: the famous financial magnate Georges Boston. Personally, I'd never heard of him, but as Reflection Club points out, to learn more about him, all we have to do is read what Rellington Stone magazine has to say?an entire issue of which is included in the CD booklet. Ha! Ha!Musically, there are plenty of similarities to TAAB, the most striking being Paul Forrest's singing style, with a slightly nasal voice very similar to that of Ian Anderson from the '70s. On *Still Thick As A Brick*, we also find that same playful flute that pops up at any moment, that same sense of rhythmic disruption, that recurring acoustic guitar developing highly catchy folk-rock themes, that anachronistic yet electrifying harpsichord, that delightful Hammond organ?worthy of John Evan's?an instrument particularly showcased on the exhilarating "The Foray of the Sharks " (5:37) or the very Tull-esque rock track "The Great Dance Around the Golden Calf" (3:35).Reflection Club intentionally set out to make an album "in the style of" and has succeeded in creating a thrilling work, close in spirit to TAAB (not to mention the very obvious nods) but one that manages to stand on its own, with some tracks less tied to Jethro Tull's '70s style. For example, the jazzy tones of "Nervesoothers" (3:10) place it more firmly between Camel and The Tangent. Furthermore, the contributions of guest musicians on sitar and violin, as well as a few brass notes (likely played on a synthesizer), judiciously enrich the atmosphere. And Reflection Club doesn't hesitate to vary the moods, stepping away from the bouncy symphonic folk-prog typical of Tull to embrace a tender pop-rock sound on the aptly named "Sentimental Depreciation" (5:19). Thus, after a few listens?from the magnificently symphonic "Prelude" (2:00) to the closing "Look Across The Sea" (4:24), a sort of sea shanty dominated by bagpipes?STAAB manages to make us forget TAAB for 48 minutes.So I have to admit that Reflection Club skillfully showcases more personality and originality than its album title would suggest. While it doesn't quite reach the creative heights of its brilliant and unsurpassed?more or less acknowledged?role model, Still Thick As A Brick captures all of its timeless charm, making for an undeniably enjoyable listen that should appeal to a wide audience, not just longtime Jethro Tull fans. And if Ian Anderson's TAAB 2 didn't quite win them over, they can safely give this Still TAAB a listen to make up for it.
items._genre: prog folk / progressive rock / psychedelic rock
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是向Jethro Tull经典专辑《Thick As A Brick》的致敬之作，由柏林音乐人Lutz Meinert领导的Reflection Club创作，成员包括吉他手、歌手、长笛手等多位乐手。专辑并非简单翻唱，而是讲述了一个关于金融大亨Georges Boston的虚构故事，CD内页还包含一本虚构杂志的完整内容作为叙事补充。音乐上保留了Tull标志性的长笛演奏、簧风琴、管风琴元素，以及具有民谣摇滚色彩的吉他主题，同时融入了西塔琴、小号等乐器，丰富了音响层次。部分曲目偏向爵士化处理，介于Camel与The Tangent之间；末曲则以风笛主导的海上民谣形式收尾。尽管编曲考究、对原作还原度高，但整体仍属于对已有风格的精致模仿，在原创性和实验性方面突破有限，偏向学院派致敬传统的制作思路。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Formed in 1997 from the ashes of Violet District?making it one of the oldest active neo-prog bands today? RPWL started out as a simple Pink Floyd tribute band but quickly managed to branch out?without betraying that influence?finding, as early as the album *God Has Failed* (2000), a sound and style all its own that has endured to this day, with just a few stylistic variations. Musically, *Crime Scene* doesn't shake things up. To our great delight, we find Yogi Lang's hazy melodies sung languidly in his velvety voice, and Kalle Wallner's majestic guitar, as determined as ever to deliver his beautiful Floydian solos that soar and glide along a thread suspended in the sky. All of this has always played a major role in the addictive charm of this timeless music. The absence of keyboardist Markus Jehle is the only notable change in this regard, leaving the spotlight entirely to Yogi Lang and his synthesizers?which are a bit more subdued than usual, though he doesn't forget to treat us, toward the end of the album, to his unchanging and unmissable Mini-Moog solo in the purest spirit of Manfred Mann's MMEB era. Certain tracks on *Crime Scene*, however, offer some welcome surprises, such as the lively intro to the brilliant and powerful "Victim of Desire," which is closer in style to Yes than to Pink Floyd. And the touch of '60s psychedelia on "A Cold Spring Day in '22." The heavy, offbeat riff?bordering on stoner rock?in "Another Life Beyond Control" also stands out in an album that some might find a little too polished. "King of the World" (12:51) is the album's pi�ce de r�sistance, unusually long for the band, which allows it?without any lulls, on a rhythm section once again closer to Yes than to Pink Floyd?to traverse a whole range of musical emotions worthy of the golden age of '70s prog, against a backdrop of Mellotron evoking the gloomy moods of our youth, when we walked with our heads down and raised them only to implore the heavens to restore our childlike carefreeness. Where the Bavarians are most surprising is in the theme?anything but trivial?chosen for their eighth studio album. The memorable *Tales from Outer Space* (2019) imagined that salvation for our species would come from space. After the interstellar journey comes a plunge into the deep night of the human soul to shed light on its most violent aspects. As its title makes quite clear, *Crime Scene* doesn't offer a selection of fairy tales for young children but instead sets out to recount a series of edifying stories. Starting with the dark "Victim of Desire," a veritable encounter with a nightmare, A disturbing news item that might provoke a sense of unease in the most sensitive among us, as if certain symptoms of some kind of post-traumatic neurosis?one we might be suffering from without even knowing it?were resurfacing. Through a story as sad as the sun's permanent absence, the bluesy "Red Rose" attempts to show us just how far mad love can lead. The catchy and effective "A Cold Spring Day in '22" in turn tells us another deeply grim story of a decimated family. It's a masterclass in the art of contrast between music and lyrics. Violence in our society?violence committed by human beings against one another, self-destructive and unnatural?has it not been present since the dawn of time, ever since this species came to be called "human"? Violence is everywhere?all around us and within each of us. But above all, *Crime Scene*, as a mirror reflecting the sickening prevalence of all violence against women perpetrated by men, presents us with an image that leaves no one indifferent. We may feel very distant from the dramatic situations depicted here?more or less graphically?and yet at the same time feel entirely affected. Are we all potential victims? And are we all potential monsters? Through six disturbing stories, curiously set to pleasant, harmonious melodies?music that is relatively peaceful by comparison?RPWL attempts, with *Crime Scene*, to offer an objective perspective that sends a chill down your spine.
items._cn_summary: RPWL是一支成立于1997年的新前卫摇滚乐队，风格深受Pink Floyd影响，融合Yes的节奏元素。《Crime Scene》是其第八张录音室专辑，延续了乐队标志性的悠扬人声、流畅吉他独奏与合成器音色。键盘手Markus Jehle的缺席使Yogi Lang的合成器更加突出，但仍包含乐队招牌的Mini-Moog独奏。部分作品融入60年代迷幻元素与stoner rock式重型 riff，Yes式节奏段落亦时有出现。专辑主题围绕人类灵魂深处的暴力与创伤展开，通过多首叙事性歌曲探讨疯狂之爱与噩梦般的遭遇。Mellotron与长篇曲目构建出70年代前卫摇滚的壮丽感，但在创新性与跨界融合方面较为有限。

items.body: Review by KansasForEver4 — Five years have passed since CASTANARC's rather mediocre *The Sea of ​​Broken Vows*, which featured eleven tracks ranging from three to five minutes in length?none of them particularly progressive in ambition. This time around, the approach is worlds apart from its predecessor: the album consists of just three tracks, with even the shortest one exceeding the length of the longest song on the 2021 release. One might well call this a "palace revolution"?a genuine surprise, as you can imagine.To appreciate CASTANARC, you first need to like Mark Holiday's somewhat distinctive voice?especially since the album is heavily vocal-driven, though the singing is superb. Yet CASTANARC is also defined by Mark Powell's multifaceted keyboards, which appear all over the album; there is plenty of piano, very little organ, and likely many sounds run through a Mellotron-style filter, with the smooth, fluid synthesizer work serving as the Doncaster band's trademark.We must also mention?lest anyone be overlooked?Neil Duty's excellent guitar work on the second track, "Ceasefire for the Innocent" (Duty previously appeared on the band's 1984 debut, *Journey to the East*, alongside Holiday and Powell); guest musician Dave Holley's contribution is equally impressive on the short "Cue Rain" (though at six minutes, "short" is relative); and the rhythm section?Peter Robinson on bass and Charlie Morgan on drums?delivers a solid, highly competent performance.While it doesn't break the mold with radical originality (remaining firmly within a very conventional neo-progressive vein), it is a fantastic surprise given the band's previous output.
items._cn_summary: Castanarc这张专辑与前作风格截然不同，从十一首三至五分钟的短曲转向仅三首但篇幅大幅拉长的长篇作品，以Mark Holiday声乐为主导，叠加Mark Powell多层次的键盘演奏，包含钢琴、Mellotron风格音色及流畅的合成器线条，吉他手Neil Duty在第二曲展现出色的独奏段落，节奏组稳定扎实。整体仍严格遵循neo-prog的常规框架，缺乏对类型的突破性拓展，长篇幅结构也未带来明显的实验性张力或前卫探索。对于偏好前卫实验、爵士即兴或电子融合的听众而言，这是一份做工精致但风格保守的复古流派回归。

items.body: Review by DimitrisTheHead — Another really strong Procol Harum album, after their debut. Procol Harum is a great example of a less-is-more band, delivering strong music without being to complex or trying to be sophisticated. The music is piano/organ/vocal driven, the trademark Procol Harum sound, led by Gary Brooker and his warm, emotional voice. Matthew Fisher on the organ is again fantastic. The album is not loaded with guitar, but when Robin Trower comes in, he delivers some really tasty and artful sounds.I like all the songs here, and the highlight is the heavy psychedelic/progressive suite "In Held 'Twas In I" with classical and Eastern music influences.
items._cn_summary: Procol Harum的第二张专辑延续了首作的简约美学，以钢琴、管风琴与人声为核心驱动力。Gary Brooker温暖且富情感张力的嗓音，搭配Matthew Fisher精湛的管风琴演奏，构成了乐队的标志性声响。专辑并未大量使用吉他，但Robin Trower每次加入时都带来细腻而富有艺术性的独奏。长达十七分钟的组曲'In Held 'Twas In I'是专辑核心，融合了古典与东方音乐元素，在迷幻氛围中展现出渐进式的发展逻辑。整体而言，这是一张克制而内敛的前卫摇滚作品，以旋律与情感驱动而非技巧堆砌为特征，对于偏好实验与即兴路线的听众而言，其保守倾向较为明显。

items.body: Canadian electronic duo Delerium release their 16th studio album, “Exaudire”, on 22 January 2027 via Metropolis Records. The album arrives on regular CD and as a limited edition double vinyl pressed on oxblood-colored vinyl in a deluxe gatefold sleeve. The title “Exaudire” is Latin for listening, hearing and being heard. Metropolis Records describes the album as moving between the tangible and the dreamlike, built from electronic textures, expansive atmospheres and guest vocal performances. Side-Line previously reported on the album’s lead single, Into the Light, which embeds portions of Diamanda Galás’s 1986 recording “Deliver Me from Mine Enemies: IV. Ε Ξελόυ Mε (Deliver Me)” from her album “The Divine Punishment”. Exaudire by Delerium ‘Exaudire’ tracklist and guest vocalists The 12-track “Exaudire” features five different guest vocalists across its running order, confirmed via the album’s Bandcamp listing: “Higher Power” (feat. Mimi Page), “Into the Light” (feat. Diamanda Galás), “Dream Palace” (feat. Magic Wands), “Buried Light” (feat. Mimi Page), “Apocalypse” (feat. Inna Walters), “Stolen” (feat. Phildel), “Into the Unknown” (feat. Jaël), “Multiplying Zero” (feat. Inna Walters), “Chasing the Wind” (feat. Mimi Page), “Exaudire”, “Had to Go” (feat. Jaël) and “Litany” (feat. Mimi Page). Mimi Page is an American singer-songwriter and composer who has released four full-length albums since 2011. Magic Wands, a dream pop trio from Los Angeles, are also signed to Metropolis Records, with the albums “Switch” (2023) and “Cascades” (2025). Jaël, a Swiss singer, previously collaborated with Delerium on the 2003 EP “After All” and the album “Chimera”. Inna Walters, based in Nashville, already appeared on Delerium’s 2023 album “Signs”. Phildel is a classically trained English singer, pianist and songwriter from London. Delerium songs have previously appeared in the films “Brokedown Palace” and “Lara Croft: Tomb Raider”. “Silence”, the duo’s 2000 collaboration with Sarah McLachlan, was more recently heard in the BBC drama “Industry”. Side-Line also covered Peter Murphy and Boy George’s 2026 Delerium remix of “Let the Flowers Grow” and Restless Mosaic’s tribute track referencing the project. About Delerium Delerium was founded in Vancouver, Canada, in 1987 by Bill Leeb and original collaborator Michael Balch. Rhys Fulber later joined as Leeb’s main songwriting partner. Both Leeb and Fulber built their reputation in the electro-industrial group Front Line Assembly, and Delerium initially served as an outlet for dark, cinematic ambient soundscapes distinct from that project’s harder industrial sound. Early albums “Faces, Forms & Illusions” and “Morpheus” appeared in 1989. Through the 1990s, Delerium’s sound evolved from industrial electronics and ambient trance toward song-based electronic pop built around guest vocalists, a shift marked by 1994’s “Semantic Spaces”, which introduced a rotating cast of female singers on largely downtempo songs, a format the duo has used on every album since. “Karma” (1997) established Delerium’s more danceable side, and “Poem” (2000), produced with Chris Peterson, included “Silence” featuring Sarah McLachlan, which reached worldwide chart success and won a Juno Award in 2000. After the Leeb-Fulber reunion album “Chimera” (2003), Delerium continued through “Nuages du Monde” (2006), “Music Box Opera” (2012), the atmospheric “Mythologie” (2016) and “Signs” (2023), the latter featuring Inna Walters among other vocalists. “Exaudire” is Delerium’s 16th studio album and its first collaboration with Diamanda Galás.
items._genre: electronic / dark ambient / ethereal / dream pop
items._cn_summary: 本文为加拿大电子组合Delerium第十六张录音室专辑《Exaudire》的发行新闻稿式报道。专辑由Metropolis Records于2027年1月22日发行，含12首曲目，邀五位客座女声合作，包括Diamanda Galás、Mimi Page、Magic Wands等。标题取自拉丁语，意为倾听与被听见。首支单曲《Into the Light》采样了Diamanda Galás 1986年作品中的段落。专辑概念定位介于可触摸与梦境之间，依赖电子音色与广阔氛围铺陈。Delerium起源于1987年温哥华，核心成员Bill Leeb与Rhys Fulber此前在Front Line Assembly中已建立电声工业声誉。报道也回顾了组合曾为多部电影和BBC剧集提供配乐的历史。整体内容偏资讯性质，缺乏音乐细节与艺术评价。

items.body: Lacrimosa released their seventh studio album, “Fassade,” through Hall of Sermon and Nuclear Blast on 1 October 2001. The gothic metal record turns 25 this year. The Swiss duo, Tilo Wolff and Anne Nurmi, recorded and mixed “Fassade” between January and June 2001 at Impuls Musicproductions in Hamburg, with orchestral parts performed by the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg recorded in March 2001 at the Scoring Stage in Berlin. JP Genkel recorded and mixed the album, and Helge Halvé handled mastering in July 2001. Wolff arranged, produced and sang on the record; Nurmi wrote and sang the album’s English-language track, “Senses,” while Wolff wrote the remaining seven songs. The eight-track album is built around the title piece “Fassade,” a three-part composition split across tracks one, five and eight, with the remaining songs, “Der Morgen danach,” “Senses,” “Warum so tief?,” “Liebesspiel” and “Stumme Worte,” filling out a 52-minute run time. “Fassade” reached number 20 on the German Albums Chart and number 31 in Switzerland, following 1999’s “Elodia,” which had marked the band’s commercial breakthrough with the London Symphony Orchestra. “Fassade” streams on Spotify. About Lacrimosa Tilo Wolff founded Lacrimosa in Frankfurt, Germany, in 1990, recording a demo tape titled “Clamor” before launching his own label, Hall of Sermon, in 1991 to release the debut album “Angst.” A harlequin has appeared on every Lacrimosa album cover since, becoming the band’s logo. Wolff released “Einsamkeit” (1992) and “Satura” (1993) as the project’s sole member before Finnish musician Anne Nurmi, formerly of the gothic rock band Two Witches, joined as a permanent second member in 1994. Nurmi has contributed her own compositions in Finnish and English on every album since “Inferno” (1995), which became the band’s first charting release in Germany. “Stille” (1997) introduced the heavier, symphonic metal direction that defined the band’s sound going forward. “Elodia” (1999) became Lacrimosa’s commercial breakthrough, reaching number 12 in Germany with orchestral parts recorded by the London Symphony Orchestra at Abbey Road Studios. “Fassade” followed on 1 October 2001, continuing the orchestral approach with the Deutsches Filmorchester Babelsberg, an arrangement repeated on “Echos” (2003). In 2008, Hall of Sermon reclaimed the rights to the band’s back catalogue from Nuclear Blast, restoring full independence over the discography. Lacrimosa continued to release albums through the 2000s and 2010s, including “Lichtgestalt” (2005), “Sehnsucht” (2009), “Revolution” (2012), “Hoffnung” (2015) and “Testimonium” (2017), the latter a requiem in four acts dedicated to musicians who died in 2016. Side-Line marked the band’s 25th anniversary in 2015 with the announcement of a new studio album, and reported on the band’s 2021 return with “Leidenschaft,” delayed at the time by a worldwide paper shortage. Side-Line also covered the 2023 release of the double live CD “Nachts” on Hall of Sermon. “Lament,” released in 2025, completed a stylistic trilogy begun with “Testimonium” and debuted at number 7 in Germany, the band’s highest chart position since “Elodia.” Lacrimosa remains one of the longest-running self-released acts in the gothic metal scene, operating continuously through Wolff’s own label since 1991. “Fassade” turns 25 this year, marking a quarter century since the band’s most explicit engagement with themes of individuality and societal conformity.
items._cn_summary: 本文是Side-Line为Lacrimosa第七张专辑《Fassade》发行25周年所撰的资讯稿。文章详细列出了专辑的录制信息：2001年1月至6月在Impuls Musicproductions录音，由德国电影管弦乐团Babelsberg在柏林录制管弦乐部分，三段式标题作品贯穿八首曲目，52分钟时长。商业表现上专辑在德国排行榜达到第20位、瑞士第31位。文章同时梳理了乐队发展脉络，包括1995年Anne Nurmi成为固定搭档后的成员变化，以及从1997年《Stille》开始转向交响金属方向、与伦敦交响乐团合作《Elodia》的商业突破轨迹。整体属于信息性回顾稿件，未涉及具体音乐分析或艺术评价。

items.body: De/Vision, the German synth-pop duo of Steffen Keth and Thomas Adam, released their sixth studio album “Two” on 1 October 2001 through E-Wave Records, a division of Drakkar Entertainment GmbH distributed by BMG. The De/Vision “Two” album turns 25 this year. It was the first De/Vision studio album recorded as a duo, following Markus Ganssert’s departure from the band in 2000. De/Vision ‘Two’ tracklist and credits The ten-track CD runs “All I Ever Do,” “Silent Moan,” “Drowning Soul,” “Heroine,” “Blindness,” “Heart-Shaped Tumor,” “State of Mind,” “Escape the World,” “Uncaring Machine” and “Lonely Day.” Georg Kaleve produced and mixed the album, with Keth handling pre-production; Stefan Ulrich engineered the sessions, recorded across Pizza Hat and Mikrokosmos-Studio in Berlin and Palais Aux Etoiles in Bremen, and Michael Schwabe mastered the record at Skyline Tonfabrik in Düsseldorf. Achim Färber played drums, Josef Bach added piano, and Kaleve, Bach and Lars Baumgardt contributed guitar; vocalist Sandrine appears on “State of Mind” and Clara Hill supplies additional vocals elsewhere on the album. Dirk Rudolph designed the sleeve around cover photography by Christof Schulte and band photography by Harald Hoffmann. “Two” peaked at number 42 on the German album chart. Lead single “Heart-Shaped Tumor” reached number 89 in Germany that September, De/Vision’s first charting single since “We Fly… Tonight” in 1998. A Different Drum issued a separate US edition of the album in 2004, and Popgefahr Records released a 17-track deluxe reissue of “Two” in 2016, adding instrumental and remix material to the original ten songs. About De/Vision De/Vision formed in July 1988 in Bensheim, near Darmstadt, Germany, as a quartet of Steffen Keth, Thomas Adam, Markus Ganssert and Stefan Blender. Blender left in 1991. The band self-released the single “Your Hands on My Skin” in 1990 and issued “Boy on the Street” in 1992 through Synthetic Product Records, before the 1993 maxi single “Try to Forget” brought them to Strange Ways Records. The debut album “World Without End” followed in January 1994, and “Unversed in Love” arrived in January 1995, both on Strange Ways. “Fairyland?” followed in August 1996 and became the band’s first German chart entry, and “Monosex” moved the band to WEA Records in 1998, reaching number 30. Ganssert left the group in 2000, the same year “Void” reached number 34 on WEA. Keth and Adam, now a duo, signed to E-Wave Records for “Two,” released on 1 October 2001 and distributed internationally through BMG. The duo continued on E-Wave through “Devolution” (2003), “6 Feet Underground” (2004), “Subkutan” (2006) and “NOOB” (2007), before founding their own label, Popgefahr Records, in 2009. Later albums “Popgefahr” (2010), “Rockets and Swords” (2012), “13” (2016) and “Citybeats” (2018) all appeared on Popgefahr, alongside the 2016 deluxe reissue of “Two.” Keth also records with Daniel Myer of Haujobb as Devision Redux, and De/Vision themselves toured with Lakeside X and Empathy Test in 2025. Twenty-five years on, “Two” marks the album that opened the Keth/Adam duo era of the band.
items._cn_summary: 这篇乐评实质上是De/Vision第六张专辑《Two》发行25周年的纪念性新闻稿。文章详细罗列了专辑的曲目表、制作人员名单（制作人Georg Kaleve、录音师Stefan Ulrich、母带工程师Michael Schwabe等）、发行厂牌（E-Wave Records/BMG）以及德国专辑榜第42名的成绩，还追溯了乐队从1988年成立到Ganssert离队后转为二人组的历史脉络。全文缺乏对音乐本身的审美分析，未涉及编曲结构、声音设计、歌词主题或艺术定位的讨论。作为德国合成器流行二人组的转型之作，该专辑在风格上接近暗潮边缘，与用户的暗潮/工业偏好有一定关联，但其主流厂牌发行（BMG）和纯信息整理性质使其在创新性和深度评价方面明显不足。

items.body:
CLOSE YOUR EYES have dropped their fourth mini album, 256th Note, alongside a music video for ‘Drop That!’.

Released on 30 September, the seven-track project follows the K-pop boy group’s 2025 EP blackout and sees them expand their sound through jazz-inspired improvisation, hip-hop, R&B, electropop, bossa nova, and more.

Taking inspiration from the spontaneity of jazz, 256th Note centres on capturing emotions as they occur rather than containing them within conventional forms. Its title references the 256th note, one of the shortest possible moments in music, as a reflection of the fleeting and unfiltered emotions found in everyday life. The album's seven tracks also mirror the seven-note musical scale.

The record opens with ‘Open Your Eyes’, an experimental meeting of jazz improvisation, hip-hop, and R&B featuring pianist Yohan Kim and saxophonist Jacob Scesney. ‘Drop That!’, meanwhile, reinterprets Yoon Si-nae’s ‘이 밤을 즐겁게’, described as an early example of Korean jazz funk, through 1990s street hip-hop and sampling. Its accompanying music video was released alongside the album.

Elsewhere, ‘Vibe Check’ pairs piano, restrained bass, and groovy drums with the members’ vocals and rap, while ‘Slowly Bleed’ moves between contemporary pop, electropop, and alternative R&B. ‘Fool For You’ leans into vintage-inspired R&B and lo-fi textures, while ‘Baby Bossa Nova’, featuring rising R&B artist Joo Hyerin, draws from traditional Brazilian bossa nova.

The album closes with ‘Eternity’, a pop ballad featuring lyrics written with participation from all seven members. Built around acoustic piano and vocals, the song expresses the group’s feelings towards their fans, CLOSER.

Formed through PROJECT7, CLOSE YOUR EYES comprise JEON MINWOOK, MA JINGXIANG, JANG YEOJUN, KIM SUNGMIN, SONG SEUNGHO, KENSHIN, and SEO KYOUNGBAE. Since debuting in April 2025, the group’s debut mini album ETERNALT sold 316,000 copies in its first week, while follow-up Snowy Summer surpassed 200,000 copies on its first day. Their debut focus track, ‘All My Poetry’, also earned the group their first music show win nine days after debut.

Led creatively by executive producer and creative director Lee Haein, CLOSE YOUR EYES continue to broaden their musical palette on 256th Note, turning brief moments of emotion into a seven-track snapshot of the group’s evolving sound.

items._cn_summary: CLOSE YOUR EYES 发布第四张迷你专辑《256th Note》，以爵士即兴为核心概念，标题取自音乐中极短时值的256分音符，象征日常生活中转瞬即逝的情绪。七首曲目对应七声音阶，横跨爵士、嘻哈、R&B、电子流行与波萨诺瓦等多种风格。钢琴家Yohan Kim与萨克斯手Jacob Scesney参与开场曲录制，《Drop That!》重新解构韩国早期爵士放克作品。专辑中段以钢琴、贝斯与鼓构建律动，尾声《Eternity》回归原声钢琴与七位成员共同创作的抒情路线。整张专辑试图将即兴精神融入K-pop框架，但在实验深度与前卫性上仍偏向主流流行制作范畴，对追求学院派爵士或前卫融合的听众而言缺乏足够的突破。

items.body: Review by martindavey87 — 'Pulse For a Graveheart' is the second studio album by Italian progressive metal band Mind Key. Released in 2009, the group has shown a significant improvement over the four years that had passed since their debut, with stronger writing and a better-sounding production, a high quality is consistently maintained throughout the album. One major change in the bands line-up is the addition of new vocalist Aurelio Fierro. Former singer Marco Basile had a fantastic range, but at times his voice seemed quite tinny, whereas Fierro's powerful voice fits more comfortably with the music, adapting for soft, melodic sections or heavier, more aggressive parts. As expected with this genre, the musicianship is fantastic as always, featuring plenty of great interplay between all the instruments, with particular praise going to guitarist Emanuele Colella and keyboardist Dario De Cicco. There's also guest appearances by the likes of keyboard maestro Derek Sherinian, Tom Englund (of Everygrey fame), and Winger's Reb Beach.With highlights including 'Sunset Highway', 'Dead Fame Hunter', 'The Seventh Seal', 'Citizen of Greed' and 'Graveheart', this is a solid progressive metal album and sure to please all fans of the genre.
items._genre: progressive metal / power metal / Italian prog
items._cn_summary: 意大利前卫金属乐队Mind Key的第二张录音室专辑，相比首作在作曲与制作上有所提升。新主唱Aurelio Fierro替代了原成员Marco Basile，其嗓音更贴合乐队风格切换，能驾驭柔美段落与重型段落。器乐演奏扎实，吉他手与键盘手贡献突出，并邀请了Derek Sherinian、Tom Englund、Reb Beach等客座乐手。《Sunset Highway》《The Seventh Seal》等曲目体现了该类型标准的复杂编曲与器乐交织。作为一部类型作品整体质量可靠，但对寻求实验性突破或跨界融合的听众而言缺乏惊喜，属于该流派框架内的稳健延续而非艺术拓展。

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑的核心是一位年轻编曲家查理·里斯为大乐队重新编配的曲目，由中音萨克斯手马丁·斯皮克组建的特别编制乐团演绎。里斯曾是斯皮克的学生，仍在二十多岁，他在斯皮克原有编曲的基础上进行了扩充和增强，使作品呈现出饱满的光泽感。作为典型的现代爵士大乐队编制，乐团通过精心的编配展现了对原曲的重新诠释。这张合辑同时回顾了查尔斯·劳埃德和埃里克·多尔菲等爵士历史人物的作品，体现了一定的爵士传统脉络。然而，从乐评内容来看，信息量较为有限，主要聚焦于编曲者的背景介绍，对音乐本身的创新性和实验性描述不足，难以判断其在前沿爵士领域的独特价值。整体定位偏向学院派主流爵士方向。

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items.body: Review by DimitrisTheHead — My Greek fellowmen will not like what I have to say about this album. Because it's really bad. I understand that at the time all the rising musicians were trying to blend and incorporate their influences into their music but this album does not really work out. Some British psychedelia, some pop influences, some Greek folk elements, which does not blend well and the record is all over the place.Despite the respect I have for Demis Roussos, the best tracks here are sung by Claude Chauvet, "End of the world" & "Rain and tears". The two tracks that justify the two stars, otherwise I would have given this record one star. As I was writing this review I almost forgot to mention that "The shepherd and the moon" is easily one of the worst songs I have ever heard! Yikes!
items._cn_summary: 这张1968年的专辑试图将英国迷幻、流行与希腊民间元素熔于一炉，但乐评指出三者未能有机融合，整体显得支离破碎。评论者仅认可由Claude Chauvet演唱的《End of the World》和《Rain and Tears》两首曲目，认为它们勉强支撑住两星的评价，其余作品包括《The Shepherd and the Moon》被形容为极为糟糕。Demis Roussos的演唱虽受敬重，但未被视为亮点。整体而言，专辑虽有融合意图却缺乏统一性与深度，与用户偏好的实验前卫、自由爵士或暗潮等方向距离较远，制作上偏向早期前卫摇滚的探索，但未达成有意义的艺术突破。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — An unfortunate fate of some artists of the 1970s lies in the rapid evolution of "popular" music of that time. A band conceived in the early 1970s, formed in the mid 1970s, and finally committing their sound to new generations, even if mostly within their own family tree, in the late 1970s would be behind the times from the outset. In the case of Finnish chameleons KAAMOS, it might not have mattered since their sole release wouldn't have been original 5 years earlier, but in 1978 it was so distinctly undistinguished as to almost be innovative, but no. A pastiche of palettes from the late 1960s and early 1970s, mostly in a heavy rock vein with brushes of folk and blues, it recalls pretty much every band that was at least critically fashionable at that time, including WIGWAM which didn't sound particularly Finnish either. The playing is very competent, especially the lead guitars, organs and rhythm section, but, while they were clearly familiar with each other, I can't help feeling it's all a bit too democratic. Best deeds here would be the wildly but admirably mercurial "Strife" and the engaging instrumental "Barokki", but they can only save this one from complete ignominy.
items._genre: progressive folk / heavy rock / blues rock
items._cn_summary: 这是一张芬兰乐队于1977年代末发行的唯一专辑，融合了1970年代前期的前卫民谣、重摇滚与布鲁斯元素。评论指出乐队演奏技术相当成熟，尤其在主音吉他、风琴与节奏组方面表现出色，但整体风格过于折衷且缺乏鲜明个性，像是同时期多个流行乐队的拼贴，难以在1978年的语境中展现真正的艺术突破。专辑中较为突出的两首作品是风格变化丰富而精彩的《Strife》和以器乐为主的《Barokki》，但它们也只能将整张专辑从彻底的平庸中稍作挽回。整体而言，这是一张在风格定位上模糊、技术过关但缺乏创新性的作品，与实验前卫、世界音乐融合或暗潮等取向相距甚远。

items._cn_summary: 这是日本Shibuya-kei风格乐队SATELLITE LOVERS的首张专辑重发版本，由DJ桥本彻共同制作，原始发行于1994年。乐队以灵魂乐为根基，创作出具有永恒感的旋律，同时融入独立音乐的清新气质，吉他、小提琴、贝斯等器乐构成层次丰富的编曲。整张作品被描述为将九十年代前半段日本都市流行场景的空气封存下来的产物，保留了那个时代特有的都市感与浪漫情怀。从文章信息来看，这是一张定位明确的复古风格重发唱片，面向Shibuya-kei爱好者，评论以简介性质为主，并未对音乐细节展开深入分析。

items.body: The LP has been built from archival vocal recordings of late frontman Mark E Smith dating from 2001 to 2014 The Fall are releasing their "definitive" final studio album, Post Script. Coming nine years on from 2017's New Facts Emerge, the band's 32nd studio LP was built from archival vocal recordings of late frontman Mark E Smith dating from 2001 to 2014. The musical backing was completed by long-time collaborators and former manager / producers Ed Blaney and Simon Archer. The nine-track record brings together garage rock and spoken word pieces, according to a press release. It will be released on CD and vinyl formats. Cog Sinister will release Post Script on 2 October 2026. ... The post The Fall Reveal Final Studio Album, ‘Post Script’ appeared first on The Quietus.
items._cn_summary: The Fall 即将于2026年10月通过 Cog Sinister 厂牌发行其第32张也是最后一张录音室专辑《Post Script》，距离上一张专辑《New Facts Emerge》已过去九年。该专辑的核心素材来自已故主唱 Mark E Smith 于2001至2014年间录制的存档人声片段，乐器部分由长期合作者 Ed Blaney 与 Simon Archer 补录完成。整张专辑共九首曲目，将车库摇滚与口语化文本朗诵段落并置，试图在已故主唱的声线残片上构建一张完整作品。这种做法虽然具有文献意义，但在声音创新与跨界融合方面信息极为有限，文章本身仅为简短新闻稿，几乎不涉及音乐本体评论。作为后朋克领域重要乐队的收官之作，其主要受众仍局限于既有粉丝群体，与实验、前卫、电子等更广泛的探索性音乐语境关联较弱。

To begin with, the lineup, Lothar Meid (bass and vocals), J�rg Evers and Klaus Ebert (guitars), and Keith Forsey, served as the backing band for pop and country-tinged singer Peter Maffay on his album Omen (1973). Confusion may have arisen because the members of Achtzehn Karat Gold also participated in Amon D��l II's Vive La Trance!. As for the album itself, it leans toward ballads and glam rock reminiscent of Udo Lindenberg, which is by no means a bad thing; it is well-crafted, though the track "Flying" does take off a bit and could arguably be linked to the aforementioned Krautrock genre.The same could be said of "Goldrush": the interplay between the two guitars and the bass creates an aura of intrigue, mystery, and danger. However, "Star-Eyed" features vocals reminiscent of Marc Bolan and a sound akin to T. Rex, while "Dr. Stein" and "I Am Just a Man" venture into country and rhythm and blues territory, recalling the stylistic shift of another band, Improved Sound Limited, which briefly flirted with Krautrock before changing direction in 1973. The album encompasses everything from solid German-style rock 'n' roll (in the vein of Udo Lindenberg) and glam to distinctly pop-oriented tracks like "If My Guru Would Know" and the jazzy, Lou Reed-esque "Cool"; it is a well-crafted, eclectic record, though it falls short of achieving true Krautrock status.
items._genre: glam rock / pop rock / German rock
items._cn_summary: 这张1973年专辑由Peter Maffay的伴奏乐队录制，整体风格偏向德国式摇滚与华丽摇滚，混入了民谣、节奏布鲁斯和乡村元素。乐评明确指出该作品与Krautrock关联不大，标题中的分类名实不符。专辑曲目风格较为多样，包括类似T. Rex的华丽摇滚作品，以及带有Lou Reed气质的爵士化曲目和流行导向的歌曲，编曲工整但缺乏实验性突破。作为一支主要为商业歌手伴奏的乐队作品，其制作偏向大众市场，与实验、前卫或电子方向距离较远。虽然部分曲目如'Flying'和'Goldrush'的吉他与贝斯互动展现出一定趣味性，但整体仍属于主流摇滚范畴内的折衷之作。

items.body: Review by brainsuccasurgery — Since its inception in 2015, the ESP musical project of Tony Lowe has released almost one album a year. In 2023, we had discovered the symphonic Reverie (in French but without accent) where contrary to his habit, the english multi instrumentalist was in the stand alone position, including vocals. Obviously, the inspiration failure is not for now. In 2024, in partnership with the singer-songwriter Louise Browne and her soft voice, Lowe has offered us Silver Waves ~ Astral Dreams, his ninth album under this band name, always illustrated by the essential Cheryl Stringall (she also holds the keyboard - strings on two tracks while dealing with the Sunn Creative label).From "Curious Dreamer - The Dreaming Field", Tony Lowe takes up business where he left off in 2020 after the excellent Phenomena: a mix of bright and languid pop-prog ("Curious Dreamer") and elegant instrumental jazzy prog ("The Dreaming Field"), the combination of two styles in the same piece seems a bit artificial here, comments that had already been noted on the previous record. "Silver Waves" (7:39) is most convincing, especially for its sensitive melody and its mesmerizing recitative set on a slow tempo that eventually accelerates in bizarre technoid rhythmic, the transition between the two parts being once again obvious. Sung in angelic voice by the Londoner Louise on a slow rhythm, �Glorious Persuasion� (7:40) begins once again with a beautiful relaxing melody, Tony being an example in this field.And for the third time in a row, which is becoming a formula, almost a gimmick, the rhythm suddenly accelerates, always so abrupt, to give way to a kind of irresistible electro discoid rock that brings us in the atmosphere of the 80s at the time of the band Propaganda. To put it more clearly, it seems that "Glorious Persuasion" is made of two separate pieces without really hurting the listener's enjoyment. �High Inspiration - It Wasn't a Dream� is the same mixed formula but this time in reverse. There are two distinct parts and no apparent connection in the same piece but the part of the song is placed before the staccato allegro, illuminated by discreet interventions of a Tony Banks-like synthetizer, followed by a dreamy ballad full of feeling. �The Brightest Star� (5:55), pretty country-pop feel good, with a soft and light atmosphere, enjoys a floydian guitar solo on a Hammond organ background that takes it into a whole other dimension. On "Life Pod" (4:34), a dynamic instrumental that would not have disavowed Alan Parson, the organ is found in a more important jazzy role, supported by an overflowing bass, mixed with love, played by Steve Gee as an exceptional guest. Silver Waves ~ Astral Dreams has reserved his best part for the end: �Love Returns� (5:45), a ravaging slow as in the most beautiful days of the most romantic Barclay James Harvest. Perhaps the most beautiful melody ever composed by Tony, who was never stingy, a positive music of the kind to send us back to the infinite in which our mind is lost while listening to it, daughter of the spiritual world, illuminated by the day of heaven, animated by a divine breath. Silver Waves ~ Astral Dreams is not the most progressive album of ESP Project but it's one of the most enchanting and sophisticated, sublimated by a Louise Browne in weightlessness. And we are already hoping for the next one to come in 2025, a promise of soothing melodic pleasures, if Tony Lowe's magical creativity does not falter.(previously published in Big Bang # 127 (prog french magazine))
items._cn_summary: ESP Project由多乐器演奏家Tony Lowe主理，2024年与伦敦歌手Louise Browne合作推出第九张专辑。整体以明亮的流行前摇与慵懒的器乐爵士前摇交替为结构，慢板旋律与节奏突变为两大手法。Louise的嗓音柔和空灵，Tony Banks式合成器、Hammond风琴与Floyd式吉他独奏穿插其中，器乐数位致敬Alan Parsons与Barclay James Harvest等老派前摇传统。制作以Sunn Creative独立厂牌发行，配有Cheryl Stringall的视觉设计。乐评指出曲目存在两段拼接过于割裂、缺乏自然过渡的问题，反复使用的'慢板转快板'公式有沦为套路之嫌。整体风格温和抒情，更接近复古抒情摇滚和柔和流行前摇，与实验前卫、学院爵士、电子或暗潮等取向距离较远。

items.body: Review by yarstruly — TAKEN FROM MY REVIEW ON MY BLOG "SCOTT'S SONG BY SONG SPOTLIGHTS" Which has links for purchasing, and more.Clicked 5, but really a 4.75The prolific UK composer and keyboardist Clive Nolan may be best known as the keyboardist in Pendragon and Arena (see my spotlight on Arena on this blog), but he has really done so much more! He is also part of the bands Shadowland and (formerly) Strangers on a Train. Furthermore, he has a bachelors and masters degree from the London College of Music, and has written, produced and staged musical theater productions with his Caamora Theatre Company. He has also been a part of numerous collaborations, including three albums with Oliver Wakeman. The man is a musical mastermind. His latest solo project "Song of the Winter Throne", due to be released on Friday October 2, is a massive undertaking. It consists of a main CD and a Bonus CD totaling approximately 2 hours in length. The subject of this concept album is H�kon H�konarson, aka Hakon IV, or Hakon the Old. He was a Norwegian King born in 1204, and reigning between 1217-1263, a whopping 46 years! (Interestingly, a Norwegian musician, whose band The Windmill also has been given a Spotlight, Morten L. Clason assisted Clive Nolan in engineering the album.) As H�kon H�konarson ascended to the crown at the age of 13, he was initially King in name only and regent Earl Skule B�rdsson pulled the strings until H�kon reached adulthood. However, B�rdsson would later declare himself king even as H�kon was still on the throne. The true king would have the usurper executed in 1240 and continued his reign. This execution put a close to the long Norwegian Civil War into which H�kon himself was born. His reign is considered to be the zenith of medieval Norwegian civilization.There are a large number of people involved in bringing Clive's musical vision to life. The primary instrumentalists are: Clive Nolan - Keyboards, Orchestration and ProgrammingMirko Sangrigoli - Drums and GuitarsStig Andre' Clason - GuitarsMorten L. Clason - FluteHennie Hagen Johnsen - GuitarsArnfinn Isaksen - BassMeanwhile, the main cast members are:Gemma Ashley - SolveigRyan Morgan - H�kon H�konarsonChristina Booth - TyraClive Nolan - Music & LyricsNatalie Barnett - Freja Ross Andrews - The StorytellerAdditionally, there are 38 members of the chorus, so I will include a picture of that page of the CD booklet, so they get the credit they deserve. (Scroll to the bottom.)Many readers will surely notice the name of Christina Booth, the amazing vocalist of the Band Magenta. Stig Andre' Clason is the son of the aforementioned Morten Clason, who also plays with The Windmill.The album comes courtesy of Anne-Claire of Bad Dog Promotions. As always, I am free to call it as I hear it, and I receive no additional compensation. As per my usual method, this is a cold listen.Obviously, this is a massive production, so let me get on with it and dive into the music!Track 1 - Born in Shadow (3:14)This begins with some sound effects and the narration from Ross Andrews, in dramatic style. Equally dramatic music follows, creating an overture for what is to come. The massive chorus is put to use on this, yet the drums and underlying rhythm keep a rock feel in the music, despite how symphonic it is. A massive opener!Track 2 - The Woman from Varteig (4:34)This begins without a pause from the opener, but the music drops to a drone. Ross Andrews continues the story, discussing the circumstances of H�kon H�konarson's birth. Christina Booth as Tyra sings first, and is joined by both of the other women in their characters. They sing of how they will protect the boy to ensure the safety of the would-be king. Being born "illegitimately" during a civil war was a great danger to the boy. The vocals are flawless and set the tone magnificently. Track 3 - Wolves Gather (3:03)A traditional drum and sound effects accompany Ross Andrews' narration, then foreboding music with chanting enters and then Gemma Ashley and Natalie Barnett sing beautifully in harmony. Power chords from the guitars help to accent the mood of the music.Track 4 - Flight of the Birkebeiners (3:27)The Storyteller continues the saga, then the dramatic music takes over. The string parts are somewhat reminiscent of the piano part on "The Lamb Lies Down on Broadway" (Genesis). The chorus joins in making the scene even more dramatic. Fantastic piece of classical-level music.Track 5 - The Hidden Prince (4:12)The Storyteller continues, then H�kon (Ryan Morgan) joins in for the first time. He sings of the circumstances of his upbringing in the woodlands. A very engaging song!Track 6 - Ritual of Faith (4:29)Ross continues the story, telling of the "Trial by Ordeal" that his mother underwent to prove the boy's lineage and suitableness to become the King. The chorus, along with Tyra and Freja bring the tale to life. A powerful song, fantastically delivered by the amazing cast of musicians Nolan has assembled. Track 7 - The Puppet Crown (4:22)The Storyteller tells us how H�kon was King in Name Only, ruled over by Regents. H�kon sings that it is "The Puppet Crown" along with Solveig. The chorus tells us:This is the puppet Crown,I wear the gold, I wear the gown,But another wields the power,A hand on the hilt of a sword unbound?However, the last line of the song is:"But one day?I'll cut the strings!"The song is probably the catchiest one so far, with lots of power.Track 8 - Fractured Throne (3:40)This song tells of how even after H�kon was King in his own right, his former Regent, Skule B�rdsson, even after being given the title of Duke (the first Duke in Norway), still tried to usurp the Crown and declared himself King?spoilers, It didn't end well for Skule. All of the main characters participate in this song. The song has an air of darkness about it, but H�kon is resolute in saying "I am King, I rule alone!"Track 9 - The Sword and the Fire (6:04)Of course the storyteller starts this one off, and then H�kon and the Chorus perform together on this one. This one describes the civil war battles that finally unified H�kon's power as Skule is executed. Musically there are some odd meters here. Ryan Morgan hits a fantastic sustained high note about halfway through that is fantastic. The resolution portion of the song is so powerful! At the end of this track is the first full stop in the music.Track 10 - A Kingdom Rejoices (3:23)The storyteller describes the full coronation of H�kon as recognized by The Pope, and Norway's rejoicing, and H�kon's successes. There is some joyous music between narrative sections in a quick 6-8. Fun track!Track 11 - Frost Upon the Longships (4:38)Now that H�kon has cemented his position as King, he led Norway to become the most powerful nation in the Northern Seas. The refrains of the song are sung with only H�kon and the male members of the chorus, giving a very masculine sound. The tempo is moderately slow. There are big power chords and heavy drumming along with the orchestrations.Track 12 - Storms and Wrecks (3:51)This one describes the conflict over certain islands that broke out with rival Scotland. Mid-tempo, with some flute-like interludes. This one features Gemma Ashley's beautiful voice as Solveig. Wonderful performance!Track 13 - The King in the Mist (4:52)This is a mid-tempo bittersweet ballad, based on acoustic guitar, with H�kon describing his final days in the Orkney Islands during the Scottish Expedition. "Raise up the King in the mist, I'm ready to go home?"Track 14 - The Winter ThroneAfter the opening from the Storyteller, this one goes into a riff that sounds like a Symphonic Power Metal song. The chorus performs in Norse. It closes out the story harkening us to always remember the great reign of H�kon H�konarson!Bonus CD [Note- I have no real information about these tracks as to how they fit into the saga.]:Track 1 - We Are the Storm and The Iron (6:05)This seems to be an alternate version of "The Sword and the Fire". The lyrics are a bit different. The refrains are in English as opposed to Norse. Track 2 - Back to Varteig (4:40)One of the ladies is speaking in Norse, as opposed to The Storyteller with dramatic music accompanying. She then sings what appears to be a lullaby, in English. The other female leads join in harmony.Track 3 - Strings and Necks (3:20)I think the title refers to the guitar solo in this track. Well actually both electric and acoustic guitar solos. An outstanding (almost) instrumental track that lets the guitarists stretch out and be featured. There is a bit of a chant from one of the ladies near the end of the track. Track 4 - Crowns Across Time (4:31)This seems to be an alternate version of "The Puppet Crown". This one seems to be a little more basic in the arrangement/production; more stripped down.Track 5 - In the Mist (4:51)Once again, one of the ladies is speaking in Norse at the beginning. After that it is an alternate version of "The King in the Mist" in a more basic form, but it's sung from the perspective of one of the female characters. It seems that Clive changed his mind in regards to the point of view on some parts of the story. She speaks in Norse again at the end of the track.Track 6 - The First Prince (4:00)This is an alternate version of "The Hidden Prince" without The Storyteller at the beginning. Also a more stripped down version. I am thinking that many of these are demos/early versions. The harmonies are wonderful, only accompanied by a drumbeat at one point.Track 7 - Ritual of Faith Ceremonial Mix (3:36)No Storyteller at the beginning. There is only a basic drum accompaniment, so the vocals really pop out! The vocals are absolutely pristine!Track 8 - More Wreckage (3:50)It begins in Norse with one of the ladies speaking, as some of the others have. An alternate version of "Storms and Wrecks".Track 9 - Purely Instrumental Flight (3:33)Despite the title, I hear some "throat singing" as this begins. There are gothic choir sounds as well. This is the backing track from "Flight of the Birkebeiners" without the lead vocals. It's an impressive piece of music either way!Track 10 - Puppet Frets (4:32)The guitarists get the spotlight on this version of "The Puppet Crown".Track 11 - Frost Upon the Longships - Backing Track (4:01)The title tells you all you need to know!Track 12 - The Narration Fireside Mix (8:13)This is all of the "Storyteller" narration combined into one track. It recapitulates the opening stanza at the end, to give it a sense of completion.OVERALL IMPRESSIONS:This is begging to be staged! If anyone is capable of doing that, it is certainly Clive Nolan! With his experience in leading Caamora Theatre Company, I would not be surprised if that is already the plan. This is grand musical storytelling at its finest! The arrangements, performances, playing, singing and production are all flawless! If you are a fan of "Jeff Wayne's Musical Version of The War of the Worlds", then this is right up your alley! Three years ago, in September of 2023, I gave that album a 4 out of 5 Stars (80%). I like this one even better than that, but it is not quite one of my absolute favorites of 2026. Don't get me wrong, this is a production on an absolutely epic scale and it is achieved magnificently! Many kudos to Clive Nolan for what he and his massive cast of collaborators have accomplished here! However, I am giving it a near perfect 4.75 out of 5 (95%) as there are a few albums out there that appeal to my tastes a little more in 2026. I am certain that some will unabashedly give it a perfect score, and I certainly wouldn't fault them for it! Again, as I keep saying, 2026 has been an amazing year and prog, and almost on a daily basis, I get offered even more potentially amazing albums to review. This album certainly reinforces my assertion that 2026 will go down as one of the most amazing years in the modern prog era.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑由英国键盘手兼作曲家Clive Nolan创作，是一部以挪威国王Hakon Hakonarson生平为题材的概念专辑，采用Neo-Prog风格。制作规模庞大，包含主CD和加长CD，总时长约两小时，配置了完整的乐队编制、合唱团以及戏剧化的叙事人声，呈现出明显的舞台音乐剧倾向。乐评着重介绍了制作团队成员名单和历史背景，对音乐本身的实际音响特征与编曲细节着墨甚少。整体定位偏向传统新前卫摇滚的宏大叙事路线，在声音实验、跨界融合或当代作曲技法上几乎未见探索，与用户关注的实验前卫、即兴爵士、电子或暗潮等方向距离较远。

items.body: A Rammstein producer, a string section and a major label: Covenant made their fifth album under different conditions from the four before it. Ka2 Music, a division of Sony Music, released “Northern Light” in Europe on 30 September 2002, and Metropolis Records followed in the United States on 8 October 2002. The Swedish futurepop trio from Helsingborg had spent its previous albums on the independents Memento Materia, Off Beat and Dependent Records. The album turns 24 this year. Jacob Hellner, who had produced Rammstein’s first three albums, produced “Northern Light” after pre-production by the band. Stefan Glaumann mixed “Call the Ships to Port”, “Bullet”, “Invisible & Silent” and “Prometheus”, Ulf Kruckenberg mixed the other seven tracks, and Björn Engelmann mastered. Axwell added programming, Ricard Nettermalm played live drums and Lizzie Zachrisson sang backing vocals on “Bullet”, “Scared” and “Atlas”. The Stockholm Session Orchestra, arranged and conducted by Joakim Milder, played the strings on “Invisible & Silent”, and Ulf Ivarsson played bass on “Atlas”. Joakim Montelius wrote the lyrics for seven tracks and Eskil Simonsson for five. “Rising Sun” carries a co-writing credit for American techno producer Steve Stoll and uses elements of his tracks “Reciproheat” and “Falling Down”. The eleven tracks run 58 minutes and 39 seconds: “Monochrome”, “Call the Ships to Port”, “Bullet”, “Invisible & Silent”, “Prometheus”, “We Stand Alone”, “Rising Sun”, “Winter Comes”, “We Want Revolution”, “Scared” and “Atlas”. Ka2 issued the album as a standard CD, a limited digipak CD and a numbered gatefold double vinyl of 1,000 copies. The vinyl added four tracks not on the CD: club versions of “Bullet” and “Call the Ships to Port”, “Bullet (Funky Indian)” and “Don’t Go”. The Sony CDs carried copy protection and a label reading “Auf PC/Mac nicht abspielbar”, and early copies came with a sticker listing the “Northern Light” tour dates. Metropolis pressed its US edition as an HDCD. Two singles bracketed the release. “Call the Ships to Port” came out on 12 August 2002 as a CD maxi with remixes by Oliver Klitzing, Christian Morgenstern, Kaylab and Thomas P. Heckmann, and reached number 93 on the German singles chart. “Bullet” followed on 9 December 2002 with an Ellen Allien “Flow Mix”, a Le Dust Sucker mix and the otherwise unreleased “Atom Heart”. A “Bullet” DVD with the video and making-of footage appeared in January 2003. About Covenant Eskil Simonsson, Joakim Montelius and Clas Nachmanson, three school friends from Helsingborg in southern Sweden, started making music together in 1986 after seeing Front 242’s first Scandinavian show, and took the name Covenant in 1988. They built a studio in Nachmanson’s bedroom while studying in Lund. Their first released track, “The Replicant”, appeared on a Memento Materia compilation in 1992, and the label issued the debut album “Dreams of a Cryotank” in December 1994. Off Beat signed the trio in 1995 after a German festival appearance. “Sequencer” followed in May 1996, with the “Stalker” single and a tour alongside Haujobb and Steril later that year. San Francisco label 21st Circuitry handled the United States, where the “Theremin” EP appeared in 1997. “Europa” came out in April 1998. When Off Beat closed in 1999, Covenant moved to the newly formed Dependent Records in Germany and SubSpace Communications in Sweden, while Metropolis Records took over the American catalogue. “United States of Mind” appeared in February 2000, with the “Der Leiermann” single, and the live album “Synergy” followed in November 2000. “Northern Light” moved the band to Sony’s Ka2 division in 2002. By then Montelius lived in Barcelona and Simonsson in Berlin, with Nachmanson still in Helsingborg. “Skyshaper” arrived in March 2006, and in March 2007 the band announced that Nachmanson would no longer tour, with Daniel Myer of Haujobb taking his place on stage. The tour film “In Transit” came out on DVD in October 2007 and confirmed Nachmanson’s departure. “Modern Ruin” followed in January 2011, the first album with Myer as a full member, and Daniel Jonasson joined the live line-up that year. Andreas Catjar joined in 2013 on keyboards and guitar, playing on “Leaving Babylon” in September 2013 and on “The Blinding Dark”, released on 4 November 2016 after the “Sound Mirrors” single. Montelius told Side-Line at the time that the line-up had grown to five, and that “Covenant’s basic principle is to always evolve: change is the only constant.” The band handed out the “Fieldworks: Exkursion” EP on its German tour in February 2019 and released a cover of Yazoo’s “Winter Kills” in December 2020. Andreas Catjar-Danielsson died on 29 July 2024 after a long illness, and the charity “Andreas EP”, recorded with Simonsson, came out on Dependent Records on 17 October 2025. Twenty-four years after Ka2 pressed it, “Northern Light” remains the album that brought “Call the Ships to Port” and “Bullet” into the Covenant catalogue.
items._cn_summary: 本文是对Covenant第五张专辑《Northern Light》的纪念性资料整理，详尽罗列了制作人员、发行版本、单曲及曲目列表等内容。专辑由曾为Rammstein制作前三张专辑的Jacob Hellner担纲制作人，融入了弦乐编排与多位客座乐手贡献，编曲层面较前作更为丰富。然而，该文章本质属于发行资讯与背景信息汇编，并非具有深度评论视角的乐评，缺乏对音乐本身风格走向、声响美学或艺术价值的实质分析。此外，专辑由Sony Music旗下厂牌Ka2发行，属于主流商业渠道，且futurepop/EBM类型偏向工业化电子舞曲，与用户偏好的实验前卫、学院派爵士及当代古典等方向有一定距离。整体而言，信息量大但评论价值有限。

items.album: The Mission’s ‘Another Fall from Grace’ turns 10 on 30 September

items.body: The Mission’s tenth studio album, “Another Fall from Grace,” turns 10 this year. The English gothic rock band released the record on 30 September 2016 through Eyes Wide Shut Recordings. Wayne Hussey has described the album as a link between The Sisters of Mercy’s “First and Last and Always” and The Mission’s own debut, “God’s Own Medicine,” citing his return to 12-string guitar as part of that connection. “Another Fall from Grace” runs just over an hour across twelve tracks and was produced by Wayne Hussey and Tim Palmer, with Palmer also mixing at ’62 Studios in Austin, Texas, and mastering by James Bacon. All songs were written by Hussey, except “Another Fall From Grace,” “Can’t See the Ocean for the Rain” and “Valaam,” co-written with Simon Hinkler. The album features a run of guest vocalists: Julianne Regan on the title track and closer “Phantom Pain,” Ville Valo of HIM on “Met-Amor-Phosis,” Gary Numan on “Within the Deepest Darkness (Fearful),” Evi Vine on “Can’t See the Ocean for the Rain” and “Never’s Longer Than Forever,” and Martin Gore of Depeche Mode on backing vocals for “Only You & You Alone.” Duke Garwood contributes alto clarinet and saxophone on “Phantom Pain.” The tracklist runs “Another Fall From Grace,” “Met-Amor-Phosis,” “Within the Deepest Darkness (Fearful),” “Blood on the Road,” “Can’t See the Ocean for the Rain,” “Tyranny of Secrets,” “Never’s Longer Than Forever,” “Bullets & Bayonets,” “Valaam,” “Jade,” “Only You & You Alone” and “Phantom Pain.” The album peaked at number 38 on the UK Albums Chart, number 2 on the UK Rock & Metal Albums Chart and number 49 in Germany. A deluxe edition followed in 2017 under the title “The Complete Another Fall From Grace,” adding a bonus disc and DVD. About The Mission The Mission formed in Leeds, England, in 1986 after Wayne Hussey and Craig Adams left The Sisters of Mercy. The pair recruited guitarist Simon Hinkler and drummer Mick Brown, initially performing as The Sisterhood before settling on The Mission. The band signed to Mercury/Phonogram’s Chapter 22 offshoot and released its debut single, “Serpent’s Kiss,” in 1986, followed by the debut album “God’s Own Medicine” in 1986, which reached the UK top ten. Through the late 1980s and 1990s, The Mission released a run of albums including “Children” (1988), “Carved in Sand” (1990), “Masque” (1992) and “Neverland” (1995), with several lineup changes affecting the rhythm section while Hussey remained the constant frontman. The band went on hiatus multiple times before reconvening for later studio work, including “God Is a Bullet” (2007), “The Brightest Light” (2013) and “Another Fall from Grace” in 2016, the latter recorded with Craig Adams back on bass and Mike Kelly on drums alongside Hussey and Hinkler. “Another Fall from Grace” brought together guest contributions from Gary Numan, Martin Gore, Ville Valo and Julianne Regan, produced by Tim Palmer and released through Eyes Wide Shut Recordings. Ten years on, the album stands as one of the band’s most complete studio statements of its post-2000s period.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章并非传统意义上的乐评，而是关于The Mission乐队第十张录音室专辑《Another Fall from Grace》发行十周年的回顾性新闻报道。文章以信息罗列为主，涵盖了专辑的基本制作信息（由Wayne Hussey和Tim Palmer制作、在德克萨斯州录音）、客串乐人名单（包括HIM的Ville Valo、Depeche Mode的Martin Gore、Gary Numan、All About Eve的Julianne Regan等）、曲目列表以及英国和德国的榜单成绩。文章还简要回顾了乐队从The Sisters of Mercy分裂后于1986年在利兹组建的历史。作为一张2016年发行的哥特摇滚专辑，其风格定位偏向传统哥特摇滚与后朋克的延续，缺乏显著的实验性突破。报道性质为主，内容以事实陈述代替音乐分析，对专辑的声音设计、歌词主题或艺术成就缺乏深入探讨。

items.body: 2026.09.30 ONTOMO編集部 東京・神楽坂にある音楽之友社を拠点に、Webマガジン「ONTOMO」の企画・取材・編集をしています。「音楽っていいなぁ、を毎日に。」を掲げ、やさしく・ふかく・おもしろ... 詳しく見る 9月29日、サントリーホール ブルーローズにて、第57回サントリー音楽賞を受賞した佐藤俊介（ヴァイオリン／指揮）と、第25回佐治敬三賞を受賞した「日野浩志郎新作音楽公演『Chronograffiti』」の贈賞式が行なわれた。 サントリー音楽賞は1969年の創設以来、毎年、その前年度においてわが国の洋楽文化の発展にもっとも顕著な功績のあった個人または団体を顕彰し、贈呈している。賞金は700万円。 贈賞理由には、「分断に歪み、混迷を深めるいまの時代において、芸術家にしかできないことをアクチュアルに示し続けている。楽しむだけではなく、思考を突き動かすためにこそ、音楽を。そうした佐藤のビジョンを照らし、クラシック音楽の未来の一翼を担うひとりとして、今後の歩みへの期待を示すもの」ということがあげられている。 ビーバー《ロザリオのソナタ》よりパッサカリアを演奏して喝采を浴びた後、贈賞式でスピーチを行なう佐藤俊介。 ヴァイオリニストであり、指揮者、室内楽奏者である佐藤俊介は、世界各地のピリオド楽器アンサンブルやシンフォニック・オーケストラを指揮し、ソリストとしても出演。2013～23年オランダ・バッハ協会のコンサートマスターを、18年からは音楽監督を兼務し、録音したJ.S.バッハのカンタータや器楽作品の数々は、同協会のYouTubeで見ることができる。2011年からはコンチェルト・ケルンのソリスト、指揮者、コンサートマスターを務め、2013年からアムステルダム音楽院の教授としてヒストリカル・ヴァイオリンを教えている 贈賞式に登壇した佐藤は、「たいへん光栄であると同時に、身の引き締まる思い。ブルーローズは特別な思い入れがある場所で、26年前の2000年、当時16歳だった私は日本で初めてのコンサートを行なうことになり、その会場の1つがここだった。 4歳から19歳までずっとアメリカに住んでいて、当時は日本語の敬語がうまく使えず、アンコールの曲名を伝えるのに、お客様に向かってタメ口で話してしまった（笑）。そんなデビュー当時のとんちんかんな私でさえ、何かのスタート地点に立っているという意識はあったが、まさか26年後にサントリー音楽賞の受賞者として、再びこの同じステージに上がらせていただくとは思っていなかった。 この26年間、多くの方に出会い、ご指導いただき、私の未熟さや失敗を寛容に受け入れてくださり、私の音楽家としての価値を信じてくださった。困難や迷いに遭遇した時もあったが、これらの方々一人ひとりのおかげで、今の自分がここにいることを考えると、今回の賞を受賞したのは自分だけではないということを痛感する。 本日の贈賞式も、今の私にとって新たなスタート地点であるような気がする。これからどんな経験をし、どんな出会いが待っているか、楽しみでならない。これまで私を導いてくださった先生方、共演してくださった音楽家の皆様、演奏の場を作り支えてくださった皆様、そして何より演奏会場で音楽を共にしてくださった聴衆の皆様に、心より感謝申し上げる」と述べた。 最新アルバム『BEE1H0VEN~ベートーヴェン：ヴァイオリン・ソナタ全集』が新レコード・アカデミー賞第1回大賞に輝き、2027年4月からは、東京交響楽団のクリエイティブ・パートナーを3年間務めることになった佐藤。今年5月からは、自身が創設したロマン派以降の音楽を主な対象とする古楽オーケストラ「Past Forward Ensemble」の演奏活動もスタートした。 「強い信念で周囲の音楽家を巻き込みながら、卓越した行動力で新しい音楽の潮流を作っていく。日本の次世代を担う音楽家たちに大きな影響を与え、これからますます存在感を発揮していく」（サントリー音楽財団代表理事 堤剛氏）と讃えられる佐藤が、今後ヴァイオリニストとして、指揮者として、ますます多く日本の聴衆の前に姿を現してくれることを願ってやまない。
items._cn_summary: 本文为第57届颁奖典礼的新闻报道，记录了小提琴家兼指挥佐藤俊介的获奖历程。文章介绍了其在荷兰巴赫协会的音乐总监工作，涵盖康塔塔与器乐作品的录音，同时提及新专辑获唱片学院大奖。文章核心内容为获奖感言与履历回顾，包括26年前在日本首次登台的回忆，以及对未来演出活动的展望。文末引用评委会对其信念与行动力的赞誉，表达对其在日本乐坛发挥更大影响力的期待。整体属于主流古典音乐界的人物报道，并非针对音乐本身的深度评论。

items.excerpt: LA出身の3姉妹で両親はウーマック&ウーマックのセシルとリンダ、つまり叔父はボビー・ウーマックで祖父がサム・クックというサラブレッド。とはいえ根っからの音楽業界人ではなく別の仕事も経て、遅咲きのデビュー作となる。家賃のためにUberドライバーをしていた経験を取り入れたという“Chauffeur”然り、地に足の着いた世界観と60～70年代ヴァイブの組み合わせが好ましい。モータウンやシカゴ調の正統ソウルだけでなく、くつろいだ甘茶スロウ“Monster”やラテン・ソウルな“If I Let You”はいかにもダップトーン好みなモダン・ヴィンテージ感で、淑やかなハーモニーが映える極上の現代ソウルだ。

items._cn_summary: 这是洛杉矶三姐妹的迟来首张专辑，出身音乐世家，祖父为传奇歌手山姆·库克，父母为组合乌马克与乌马克成员。尽管家族背景深厚，但姐妹三人曾从事其他职业，专辑融入了开Uber等真实生活体验。整体风格以六七十年代灵魂乐为基调，融合摩城、芝加哥正统灵魂乐元素，同时呈现达谱顿唱片偏好的现代复古感。部分曲目偏向慵懒慢板，另一些则带有拉丁灵魂乐色彩。三人的柔美和声贯穿始终，制作精良但风格相对传统保守。专辑定位为面向主流灵魂乐听众的商业化制作，与实验性、前卫性的音乐路径相距较远。

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: 这是由Martina Sorbara、Jonathan Goldsmith和Don Rooke三位音乐人合作完成的专辑，十八首短小曲目总长仅三十四分钟，以拨弦吉他、尤克里里、滑棒吉他和键盘为骨架。歌词围绕失去与宿命展开，嗓音清澈而脆弱，整体呈现出梦境般的质感。风格借鉴多元——开头曲带矿工布鲁斯气息，另有类似Cowboy Junkies的乡村灵魂曲和Dolly Parton式的弦乐调式，编曲追求极简与精准，部分曲目仅用三十八个词传达完整意境。三位音乐人各自从事影视配乐、乐队主唱和独立创作，作品是多年异地邮件合作的结晶。专辑定位于多伦多独立音乐场景，风格偏向根源民谣与独立流行的柔和交叉，与实验、前卫或电子方向相去较远。
